original_ai_output.title_zh: 乔纳森支持前警察总监以非动能方式应对恐怖主义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚前总统古德勒克·乔纳森在阿布贾出席前警察总监穆罕默德·阿布巴卡尔所著《超越子弹：民主体制下的反恐警务》一书发布会时，表态支持在反恐中超越单纯动能手段。乔纳森称反恐是跨越历届政府和世代的持续挑战，需持续投入与制度学习。该书书评人认为，该书主张在军事与非军事手段之间取得平衡，以应对叛乱分子、匪徒和绑架者相关的恐怖主义问题。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚前总统乔纳森表态支持前警察总监阿布巴卡尔主张的非动能反恐方式
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has backed a retired Inspector-General of Police (I-G), Mr Mohammed Abubakar, on going beyond kinetic approach in the fight against terrorism in the country.

key_facts.fact: 相关表态发生在阿布贾举行的新书发布活动上
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Jonathan disclosed this on Saturday in Abuja during the public presentation and formal launching of a book titled “Beyond the Bullets, Policing Terrorism in a Democratic System”, written by Abubakar.

key_facts.fact: 乔纳森称反恐是需历届政府持续投入的全国性挑战
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: It is a continuing national and global challenge that requires sustained commitment, revisionary institutional learning and cooperation across successive governments and generations.

key_facts.fact: 书评人指出该书主张军事与非军事手段平衡应对不安全问题
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the book was a recommendation for the balance of the adoption of military and non-military solutions to the country’s complex and intractable insecurity problems.
